A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the IEC 61800 MMS standard is a good choice for communication between distributed DER.
the performance overhead caused by the implementation of IEC 61950 MMS is not a major concern for most applications.
the overhead of the MMS protocol is negligible in comparison to that of TCP/IP, but the performance of the implementation is still far from optimal.
